calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY: 'I do like this one' — Synopsys' chip-design software is critical to the industry, its business isn't dependent on Nvidia financing, the market isn't watching it as closely and valuation is still very good on ~37% expected revenue growth this year; Nvidia holds ~$2.1B.

New: starting to really like it — $1B+ Amazon IP deal (Trainium/Graviton royalties), OpenAI partnership on GPT-like chip-design AI with revenue share, 15%/yr growth to 2030 guide far above Street, operating margins 44%->50%.
calls.price_at_call: Surged 10% on investor day; no explicit price given
